fate: Died at Nola on 19 August 14 CE and was declared a god.
moments: Defeats Antony and Cleopatra at Actium, 31 BCE
Named Augustus by the Senate, 27 BCE
name: Augustus (Octavian)
summary: Born Gaius Octavius, Julius Caesar's great-nephew. Adopted in Caesar's will, he won the civil wars and became Rome's first emperor.
